item.title: fix(matrix)：忽略环境账户令牌中超范围的十六进制转义（#120428）
item.summary: fix(matrix): ignore out-of-range hex escapes in env account tokens (#120428) * fix(matrix): ignore out-of-range hex escapes in env account tokens decodeMatrixEnvAccountToken guarded String.fromCodePoint with Number.isFinite, which does not bound the Unicode range: a MATRIX_* env var whose _X_ escape exceeds 0x10FFFF (e.g. MATRIX_A_X110000_B_HOMESERVER) threw RangeError out of listMatrixEnvAccountIds, crashing discovery of every env-backed Matrix account during startup and doctor checks. Escapes above the Unicode max are now rejected like any other malformed token. * chore(matrix): tighten decoder invariant comment Co-authored-by: 万拥 0668000723 * chore(matrix): clarify decoder invariant Co-authored-by: 万拥 0668000723 --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
